name: gantt-project
description: Collaborative Gantt chart project management tool

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://localhost:3001/api/health && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=true electron electron/main.js"
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && electron-builder
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
